newsitem.title: USA: Enron Global Power selects advisors.
newsitem.headline: Enron Global Power selects advisors.

text.p: Enron Global Power & Pipelines LLC said on Friday its Oversight Committee has retained Dillon, Read & Co as its financial advisor and Baker & Botts LLP as its legal counsel in connection with the evaluation of the previously announced Enron Corp proposal to acquire Enron Global Power's publicly held shares.
The Oversight Committee is a standing committee of Enron Global Power's board composed of three outside directors, the company explained.

With the completion of the selection of these advisors, the committee is now prepared to begin the process of evaluating the Enron offer. As previously announced, the committee expects the evaluation will take several weeks.
Enron Global Power is majority owned by Enron Corp.
